status: Fixed proposed acceptance scenarios for this implementation contract; edits require owner decision after implementation begins.
authority: Synthetic fault scenarios are engineering acceptance cases, not evidence of general AI correctness.

cases.name: happy_path
cases.expected: Real worker/check/reviewer/browser/publisher stages finish, exact published revision push CI succeeds, and a validated branch plus merge-decision report reaches ready_for_merge_approval. Default mode makes zero PR creation/update calls and does not wait for pull_request events.

cases.name: check_failure_repair
cases.expected: A deterministic failed check reaches the worker with original output, correction reruns affected checks and independent review; no failed attempt erased.

cases.name: review_rejection_repair
cases.expected: A reviewer rejects a deliberately inadequate synthetic implementation despite passing tests; correction and independent re-review are required.

cases.name: stale_source
cases.expected: A source, configuration, fixture, dependency-lock or generated browser-runtime change invalidates dependent evidence and publication eligibility.

cases.name: stale_docs
cases.expected: Documentation changes after review require a final documentation review; the implementation worker cannot exempt its own edits.

cases.name: browser_execution
cases.expected: An actual browser runs the generated production harness; raw result, runtime/fixture hashes and browser version are recorded. Node execution or screenshots alone fail this case.

cases.name: browser_missing
cases.expected: No supported browser backend yields capability_blocked and a concrete recovery request; a fabricated or manually relabeled pass never qualifies.

cases.name: protected_inputs
cases.expected: Changing a protected acceptance definition, evaluator, controller policy or contract invalidates the attempt and requires owner decision, never a regenerated baseline.

cases.name: decision_stop
cases.expected: A core design/criterion conflict persists a decision request with alternatives, impacts and recommendation; restart/time passing cannot approve it.

cases.name: budget_resume
cases.expected: Timeout, process crash and resume preserve cumulative elapsed time/cycle usage; child processes terminate and an exhausted run cannot restart its budget.

cases.name: publication_idempotence
cases.expected: Crash after commit/push/report generation resumes by inspecting exact remote branch/SHA and versioned report identity, without duplicate commits, lost reports or force push. A PR URL/ID is not required in default branch_report mode.

cases.name: publication_scope
cases.expected: Only reviewed task changes on the configured repository/branch publish. Dirty original checkout, unrelated files and ignored private logs are preserved/excluded.

cases.name: remote_failure
cases.expected: Remote required push quality gate failure returns its actual log/head SHA to repair; failed/unknown/pending required gates cannot become ready_for_merge_approval. Absence of a PR/pull_request event is not a failure in default mode; an incompatible PR-only required gate is reported for decision rather than bypassed.

cases.name: remote_movement
cases.expected: Target/head changes before publication or after CI force re-evaluation on the updated integration candidate; checking an older SHA is insufficient.

cases.name: failure_delivery
cases.expected: At budget/capability/decision stop, publication finalization can save a reviewed-safe incomplete branch per owner policy, but it remains incomplete and never ready for merge.

cases.name: boundary_preservation
cases.expected: Controller, protected inputs and evidence remain outside target; target package is not imported by controller; target-level lock and schema/documentation gates remain enforced.

cases.name: real_pilot
cases.expected: A real small CoRA task reaches a pushed validated branch and merge-decision report with fresh checks/browser, independent review and successful exact-head push CI without manual stage handoffs. Assert no PR is created in default mode and no merge occurs.

cases.name: truthful_status
cases.expected: Status distinguishes local acceptance, branch publication/CI/report pending, ready for owner merge, incomplete publication and merged; legacy states are not silently reclassified. Owner handoff records exact source/target revision, proposed merge and limitations without requiring a PR URL.

revision_decision: Owner-approved change from mandatory Draft PR to default branch_report delivery; prior v1 definition remains in Git history. All other gates remain required.
